title: 第十章 选择第十九章 一根线
slug: 灭门夜我易筋经大圆满
content_zh:
孙家这个儿媳妇，不是什么大门大派的女侠。
但家中富裕，自小也是锦衣玉食的长大，为了让女儿有些自保之力，其父亲将其送到了武馆，让她学点本事傍身。
她也争气，确实练得不错。
后来因为向往江湖，就跟着同一个武馆的师兄弟们，一起加入了镖局。
本想走两趟，见识见识这江湖风采，然后就乖乖回家。
哪里想到，道上遇到了强人，一翻争斗之下，镖局的人被打散了。
她自己也受了伤，一路挣扎，结果找到了孙家，就跟方书文和周青梅一样，打算在这里借宿一晚。
就这一晚……拉开了她将近二十年的噩梦。
初出茅庐的一个小姑娘，江湖经验不足，甚至对很多人口中所说的江湖，还有一层天然滤镜。
以至于，饭菜之中掺了蒙汗药，她也不知道。
一觉醒来，她就发现自己被人给绑了。
姓孙的打断了她的腿，用斧头的钝面，一点点的敲碎了她的琵琶骨，以至于时至今日，她的双手也无缚鸡之力。
她被强占了。
初时肯定是不服气的，她想逃离这里，但腿脚不便，手上没劲，学的东西全都废了。
慢慢的，她学会了忍耐。
尽可能争取孙家人的信任，终于她成功了。
姓孙的进城时，将她带上了。
但最初的时候，她没有胡乱行动，她还在隐忍。
因为她瘸了腿，双手也无力，她需要有人帮她。
几次三番进城，她都老老实实的，终于彻底取得了信任。

她这才寻了一个看上去最合适的人，跟他说明了自己的困境，希望可以被人救下逃出升天。
但是她没想到，那看上去最合适的人却告发了她，从姓孙的那里拿到了二两银子。
就是这二两银子，将她重新打回了地狱。
姓孙的生了很大的气，说她水性杨花，说她不安于室，说她想要勾搭城里的男人。
一怒之下，用刀子毁了她的脸，出手没有轻重，以至于误伤了她的一只眼睛。
而打这之后，她的日子过的越来越不好，姓孙的厌恶她这张脸，好像全然不是他的杰作一般，对她非打即骂。
要不是当时发现，她已经有孕在身，只怕，她也活不到现在。
可就算是这样，她的人生也只剩下了炼狱。
更让她绝望的是，她十月怀胎生下来的儿子，和他父亲一模一样。
一样的看着人畜无害，一样的狠毒。
每一次有人来这里借宿，她都想方设法的提醒，但是没有用。
姓孙的如有神助屡屡得手，她劝儿子不要和他爹一样，换来的则是亲生儿子的拳脚相加。
content_en:
This daughter-in-law of the Sun family is not a heroine from a well-established sect.
But his family was wealthy and he grew up in fine clothing and food. In order to give his daughter some ability to protect herself, her father sent her to a martial arts school so that she could learn some skills.
She also strives for success and does a good job indeed.
Later, because I yearned for the martial arts world, I followed my brothers from the same martial arts school and joined the escort agency.
I wanted to make two trips to see the beauty of the world, and then go home obediently.
Unexpectedly, he met a strong man on the road, and after a fight, the people from the escort agency were dispersed.
She herself was injured and struggled all the way. Finally, she found the Sun family, and just like Fang Shuwen and Zhou Qingmei, she planned to stay here for one night.
Just this night... the nightmare that had lasted nearly twenty years began for her.
A young girl who is just starting out has little experience in the world of martial arts. She even has a natural filter for what many people call the martial arts world.
As a result, she didn't know that the food was mixed with Mongolian sweat medicine.
When she woke up, she found that she had been tied up.
The man surnamed Sun broke her legs and used the blunt side of the ax to break her bones bit by bit, so that to this day, her hands are powerless to bind a chicken.
She was raped.
She must have been unconvinced at first. She wanted to escape from here, but her legs and feet were inconvenient, her hands were weak, and everything she had learned was wasted.
Slowly, she learned to be patient.
She tried her best to win the trust of the Sun family, and finally she succeeded.
When the man named Sun entered the city, he took her with him.
But at the beginning, she didn't act randomly, she was still holding back.
Because she was lame and her hands were weak, she needed help.
She went to the city several times and she was honest, and finally gained her trust completely.
She then found the person who seemed the most suitable and explained her predicament to him, hoping to be rescued and escape to heaven.
But she didn't expect that the person who seemed the most suitable would report her and get two taels of silver from the man named Sun.
It was these two taels of silver that sent her back to hell.
The woman surnamed Sun was very angry, saying that she was a promiscuous person, that she was restless at home, and that she wanted to seduce men in the city.
In a fit of rage, he used a knife to destroy her face. He did so carelessly and accidentally injured one of her eyes.
After the beating, her life became worse and worse. Sun was disgusted with her face, as if it was not his masterpiece at all, and he beat and scolded her.
If it hadn't been discovered at that time that she was pregnant, I'm afraid she wouldn't be alive now.
But even so, her life was nothing but purgatory.
What made her even more desperate was that the son she gave birth to in ten months of pregnancy was exactly the same as his father.
The same looks at humans and animals as harmless, the same viciousness.
Every time someone came to stay overnight, she tried every means to remind them, but to no avail.
Sun, if she has the help of gods, often succeeds, she advises her son not to be like his father, but in exchange, he gets punches and kicks from his biological son.
